summary: Complete independent Chinese-source audit of all 52 source units, all 126 temporal or active-hint checks, and all 39 people. Seventeen date assignments or active hints need revision: an undated Gaozu-before-empire anecdote was expanded into BC 210–206 activity for four people; Liu You acquired an unsupported BC 196 range start; Chao Cuo received a BC 155 point from an undated Jing-reign reference; the Grand Historian received BC 100 from an authorial attribution; and Masters Shen and Fangyu received BC 154 from retrospective commentary. Direct source-dated Han succession and Seven States rebellion chronology remains supported.

references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 漢已平吳楚，孝景帝欲以德侯子續吳，以元王子禮續楚。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 竇太后曰：「吳王，老人也，宜為宗室順善。

references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 不許吳，許立楚後。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 是時禮為漢宗正。

references.quote: 文王立三年卒，子安王道立。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 安王二十二年卒，子襄王注立。

references.quote: 襄王立十四年卒，子王純代立。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 王純立，地節二年，中人上書告楚王謀反，王自殺，國除，入漢為彭城郡。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 趙王劉遂者，其父高祖中子，名友，謚曰「幽」。

references.quote: 高后王呂祿於趙，一歲而高后崩。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 大臣誅諸呂呂祿等，乃立幽王子遂為趙王。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 立十三年卒，子哀王福立。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 一年卒，無子，絕後，國除，入于漢。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 遂既王趙二十六年，孝景帝時坐晁錯以適削趙王常山之郡。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 吳楚反，趙王遂與合謀起兵。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 其相建德、內史王悍諫，不聽。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 遂燒殺建德、王悍，發兵屯其西界，欲待吳與俱西。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 北使匈奴，與連和攻漢。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 漢使曲周侯酈寄擊之。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 趙王遂還，城守邯鄲，相距七月。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 吳楚敗於梁，不能西。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 匈奴聞之，亦止，不肯入漢邊。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 欒布自破齊還，乃并兵引水灌趙城。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 趙城壞，趙王自殺，邯鄲遂降。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 趙幽王絕後。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 太史公曰：國之將興，必有禎祥，君子用而小人退。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 國之將亡，賢人隱，亂臣貴。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 使楚王戊毋刑申公，遵其言，趙任防與先生，豈有篡殺之謀，為天下僇哉？
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 賢人乎，賢人乎！
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 甚矣，「安危在出令，存亡在所任」，誠哉是言也！
